snippet.title: The Night Shift – Official Launch Trailer | Noir Detective Game | Available Now on Steam & Epic
snippet.description:
Every file lies. Your stamp decides who pays for it.

THE NIGHT SHIFT is a neo-noir deduction game where you are the last desk between the accused and the cells. Cross-check documents, spot forgeries, break alibis and interrogate suspects, then stamp CHARGE or RELEASE before the shift clock runs out.

Every verdict echoes: the corrupt get richer, the wronged remember, and Internal Affairs is watching.

▶ Available now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5428700/The_Night_Shift/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-night-shift-29825e

FEATURES
• A 7-night campaign with recurring characters and 8 endings shaped by your corruption, your accuracy and your conscience
• Real deduction: interrogate suspects and push them with evidence, but push with nothing and they lawyer up
• Boss cases against The Broker's lieutenants
• Bribes pay the bills. Internal Affairs takes notes
• Manhunt mode: chase a fugitive across the city
• Endless mode with escalating forgeries
• 50 painted suspects, fully voiced and subtitled in English and Spanish

Press & media: hello@mediaverselabs.com

#TheNightShift #DetectiveGame #IndieGame #Noir #Steam #EpicGames
